description: React component for OAuth authorization page, handling user consent for app access, including UI rendering, permission handling, and redirect logic.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: React component managing OAuth authorization UI and logic.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Removes antiClickjack blocker and fetches OAuth app info based on client_id.

methods.name: handleAllow
methods.description: Handles user consent to allow OAuth app, redirects on success or shows error.

methods.name: handleDeny
methods.description: Handles user denial, redirects to error or external URL.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the authorization UI, including app icon, messages, and buttons.
